description: Basu, Sukanta and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The released HybridWind MATLAB code implements estimation of surface fluxes from wind-speed profiles. Its native description cites both a wind-profile stability method and the hybrid profile-gradient formulation. The registered wind-energy paper establishes the supporting role of stability information in wind-farm production and structural loading; it is descriptive context, not an identity alias of this code. The deposit specifies MIT terms. The model depends on its profile assumptions and measurement configuration and does not supply a general weather simulation system. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label mit-license. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
